dos.text: Always set title or ariaLabel, there's no visible text label at all in this mode, so one of the two is the only accessible name a screen reader gets.
Use type="icon ghost" for a lower-emphasis icon button, it's a supported combination in moz-button.mjs/.css.

donts.text: Don't use "icon primary" or "icon neutral", even though Figma Code Connect shows them as options: no matching CSS rule was found for either combo, [type="primary"] is an exact match not a ~= token match, so "icon primary" won't actually pick up primary styling.
Don't leave menuId unset if you need a dropdown affordance, without it there's no real panel-list wiring for open/close state or aria-expanded/aria-haspopup.
